'''Waterford Football Club''' formerly Waterford United Football Club is an [[List of association football clubs in the Republic of Ireland|Irish association football club]] based in [[Waterford]] who play in the [[League of Ireland Premier Division]]. The club was founded and elected to the league in [[1930 in Ireland|1930]].<ref name="eircom">{{cite web|url=http://www.eircomloi.ie/the-divisions/first-division/club-profiles/waterford-united/ |title=Club Profile, Waterford United |publisher=Eircom League of Ireland |access-date=28 September 2008 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090224224135/http://eircomloi.ie/the-divisions/first-division/club-profiles/waterford-united/ |archive-date=24 February 2009 | website = eircomloi.ie }}</ref> Originally the club was based at the greyhound stadium known as [[Kilcohan Park]], but moved to the [[Waterford Regional Sports Centre]] in the 1993–94 season. In 2018 the club and its players became fully professional.<ref name="New Era Begins">{{cite web |last1=Keane |first1=Matt |title=New Era Begin for Waterford FC |date=11 January 2018 |url=https://www.munster-express.ie/sports/soccer/new-era-begins-for-waterford-fc/ |work=The Munster Express |access-date=22 December 2021}}</ref>"}}
